- [.txt|--showSkippedTests.] / [.txt|-s.]

- [.txt|--debugger.] / [.txt|-D.]
- [.txt|--debugId.] / [.txt|-i.]

Operational caveats:

- [.txt|--matchAll.] and [.txt|--matchAny.] must be the last flag pair because every remaining argument is treated as filter text
- [.txt|--plainText.] is also forced automatically when stdout is redirected
- numeric aliases such as [.txt|-2.] through [.txt|-9.] still exist for stop-after-N-failures, but they are inconsistent and best treated as legacy shortcuts
- the file-driven regression suite is current-working-directory-sensitive because [.txt|mRegression_Tests.] resolves [.txt|Regression.Tests/.] from [.txt|mFS.CWD().]

[=Regression Harness=]

[.txt|mRegression_Tests.] reads, for each case under [.txt|SPO_CS/Regression.Tests/.]:

- [.txt|Name.SPO.]
- [.txt|Name.result.SPO.]
- [.txt|Name.ILT.]

Each case produces exactly three checks:

o 1. [.txt|.SPO == .result.SPO.]
o 2. [.txt|.SPO -> .ILT.]
o 3. [.txt|.ILT == .result.SPO.]

This secures three distinct contracts:

- direct SPO interpretation is semantically correct
- lowering to IL is stable
- IL execution is semantically equivalent to SPO execution

Important execution details from the code:

- the `.SPO` file under test and the `.ILT` file both run with [.txt|Module_Std.] as import
- the oracle file [.txt|.result.SPO.] runs with an empty import
- discovery uses [.txt|mFS.CWD() / "Regression.Tests".], so [.txt|mRunTests.] must be launched from [.txt|SPO_CS/.] for this suite to appear at all
- only files whose names literally end in [.txt|.SPO.] are discovered as regression sources
- files named [.txt|_*.SPO.] are intentionally skipped
- if generated IL differs from stored [.txt|.ILT.], the harness writes [.txt|Name.ILT.new.]

As rechecked on [.txt|2026-04-30.], the folder yields [.txt|49.] discovered regression source files, which means [.txt|147.] file-driven regression checks before the rest of the unit and module suites are counted.

[=Recommended Verification Routine=]

[.powershell
|Push-Location .\SPO_CS
|dotnet run --project .\SPO_CS.csproj -- --list --plainText
|dotnet run --project .\SPO_CS.csproj -- --plainText --showPassedGroups --showPassedTests --matchAny 01_02_AssignFalse
|dotnet run --project .\SPO_CS.csproj -- --plainText --matchAll mModule_Tests Maybe
|dotnet run --project .\SPO_CS.csproj -- --plainText --showPassedGroups --showPassedTests --stopOnFirstFail --matchAny 07_12_GenericTypes
|Pop-Location
.]

Run these checks sequentially. Parallel [.txt|dotnet run.] invocations against the same project can contend for build outputs under [.txt|bin/Debug/net10.0/.] and [.txt|obj/Debug/net10.0/.].
